package: K03-T3 partial: critical-path result provenance and failed receipts

observed_source.note: The fingerprint was captured from tracked working-tree file contents, including the changes under test. The dirty state is explicit; the receipt does not claim a clean commit build.

scope: Critical-path guard ran the two required suites against synthetic fixtures. A separate expected-failure fixture verified that failed counts and source identity survive in JSON. No database, server, provider, or production service was used.
limitations: The whole K03 baseline and K01 fresh database/app/worker acceptance remain incomplete.
The source fingerprint includes all tracked working-tree files. The receipt marks the worktree dirty; it does not treat the revision alone as the tested source state.
